mapper.select: SELECT a.`QUESTION_ID_1` AS QUESTION_ID, a.`QUESTION_DSCR_1` AS QUESTION_DSCR FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_ledger` a WHERE a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} GROUP BY a.`QUESTION_ID_1`
SELECT a.`QUESTION_DSCR` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` a WHERE a.`QUESTION_ID` = #{QUESTION_ID}

SELECT
b.guoku_DSCR AS `${column}`
CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN a.QUERY_ITME = '${column}' AND LENGTH('${column}')<>32 THEN a.ITME_VALUE END) > 0 THEN FORMAT(SUM(CASE WHEN a.QUERY_ITME = '${column}' AND LENGTH('${column}')<>32 THEN a.ITME_VALUE END), 0) ELSE 0 END AS `${column}`
FROM `inspection`.`inspection_statistical_table` a LEFT JOIN dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` b ON a.`ITME_VALUE` = b.`guoku_id` WHERE 1=1
AND a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID}
GROUP BY a.TASK_ID
